Writing · General Training

Instructions to candidates

  • Answer both tasks. You have 60 minutes in total.
  • Task 1 is a letter of at least 150 words. Spend about 20 minutes on it.
  • Task 2 is an essay of at least 250 words. Spend about 40 minutes on it.
  • Task 2 counts for twice as much as Task 1.
  • Switch between tasks with the tabs. You may start with Task 2 if you prefer.
  • The word count is shown under your answer. Spell check is off, as in the real test. You can copy and paste (this can be turned off in Display settings), and insert text anywhere.
  • The Tab key does not indent. Leave a blank line between paragraphs instead.
  • When time runs out, your answers are submitted automatically.
60:00

Speaking · Academic & General Training

Instructions to candidates

  • The test takes 11–14 minutes and has three parts. The examiner's questions are spoken aloud.
  • Part 1 (4–5 minutes): questions about yourself and familiar topics.
  • Part 2 (3–4 minutes): you get a task card and 1 minute to prepare, then speak for up to 2 minutes. The examiner stops you at 2 minutes.
  • Part 3 (4–5 minutes): a discussion of more general questions linked to Part 2.
  • After each answer, press I've finished. Each answer also has a time limit, as the examiner would move you on.
  • Use headphones so the microphone does not pick up the examiner's voice.

To start, check your microphone or choose to type your answers.

Reading · General Training

Instructions to candidates

  • Answer all 40 questions. You have 60 minutes, with no extra time to transfer answers.
  • There are three sections. Section 1 has short everyday texts, Section 2 has texts about work, and Section 3 has one longer text.
  • The text is on the left and the questions are on the right. Use the question numbers in the bar at the bottom to move around, and tick Review to flag a question to come back to.
  • Select any text, or right-click a selection, to Highlight it or add Notes. You can copy and paste words from the text into your answers unless this is turned off in Display settings.
  • For gap-fill questions, keep to the word limit and spell carefully. Wrong spelling is marked wrong.
  • When time runs out, your answers are submitted automatically.
60:00

Step 2 of 3

Headphone check

Put on your headphones. Select Play sound and adjust the volume until you can hear the voice clearly. In the real test you can only adjust volume during the test, not replay the recording.

This browser cannot produce the test audio. Please open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari.

Step 3 of 3

Listening

Time: approximately 30 minutes

Instructions to candidates

  • Answer all the questions.
  • You can change your answers at any time during the test.
  • Type your answers on screen while you listen.

Information for candidates

  • There are 40 questions in this test. Each question carries one mark.
  • There are four parts to the test.
  • You will hear each part once only. The recording cannot be paused or replayed.
  • For each part there is time to look at the questions before you listen.
  • At the end you have 2 minutes to check your answers. The test then ends automatically.
  • Spelling counts. Answers that go over the word limit are marked wrong.

Tip: select any text in the questions and choose Highlight or Notes, as in the real test. Tick Review in the bar at the bottom to flag a question.

The voices are generated by your device, so they sound less natural than real recordings. For the most natural voices, use Microsoft Edge or Chrome. Everything else follows the order and timing of the computer-delivered test.

Finish the test now?

Help

  • The timer at the top keeps running. It turns red with 10 minutes left and flashes at 10 and 5 minutes.
  • Use the question numbers at the bottom to move between questions. Tick Review to mark a question; its number turns into a circle.
  • In Reading, select text or right-click a selection to Highlight it or add Notes. Click a highlight to edit its note.
  • In Writing, either task can be done first. The word count is under your answer.
  • Answers are kept as you go, and each part is submitted automatically when time runs out.
  • Hide covers the screen, but the timer does not stop.
  • Colours, text size, copy and paste and real test mode are in Display settings.
